abilities.name: Bash
abilities.description: Instant shield strike deals 150 damage and weakens the target’s next attack by 30%, consumed on attack or after 8 seconds.

cast.description: Heavy shield thrust with leather strap and a quick armored air rush. Isolated game sound effect, no music, no speech, clean short tail.

impact.description: Close resonant iron shield impact, low wooden body and a few bright metal fragments. Isolated game sound effect, no music, no speech, clean short tail.

notes: Damage and weakened status apply immediately; visual recovery adds no windup.
No stun, slow, area damage, upgraded damage or timing disruption.
Use weakened loop only until next enemy attack or 8-second expiry; next-attack prose takes precedence over older continuous-reduction code.

abilities.name: Block
abilities.description: Raise a shield facing north; subsequent taps rotate clockwise. Deflect projectiles in a 90-degree arc until cancelled; movement reduced to 50%.

cast.description: A broad metal shield lifted and braced, creaking leather and armor. Isolated game sound effect, no music, no speech, clean short tail.

impact.description: A sharp projectile ricochet off a shield, metallic ping with a quick sideways zip. Isolated game sound effect, no music, no speech, clean short tail.

sustain.description: Low restrained steel shield resonance and gentle leather strain, seamless defensive holding ambience. Isolated game sound effect, no music, no speech, clean short tail.

notes: Actor n/e/s/w hold tags loop until cancellation; lower tags are separate.
Initial facing north; each tap rotates N→E→S→W with 200 ms rotation cooldown.
Gallery impact is a demonstration projectile deflection, not an automatic attack.

abilities.name: Taunt
abilities.description: Channel for 800 ms, then force enemies in a 2×2 area up to 3 tiles away to target the Warrior for 6 seconds.

cast.description: A forceful bear-like armored battle bark without words, with shield resonance. Isolated game sound effect, no music, no speech, clean short tail.

impact.description: A low red magical challenge pulse locking attention, muted brass impact and short resonant tail. Isolated game sound effect, no music, no speech, clean short tail.

charge.description: A restrained bear growl building in the chest with tightening armor straps, tension rising without words. Isolated game sound effect, no music, no speech, clean short tail.

notes: The real 800 ms channel must complete; Warrior remains stationary while channeling.
Targeting changes only; enemy movement and attack schedules remain unchanged.
Marked loop is a presentation hook for the 6-second status, not extra damage.

abilities.name: Bulwark
abilities.description: Instantly deploy a frontal 3×2 tile barrier for 4 seconds, absorbing projectiles and cone attacks from the front.

cast.description: A massive defensive wall unfurling from a shield, stone weight and ringing forged metal. Isolated game sound effect, no music, no speech, clean short tail.

impact.description: A spell or projectile absorbed into a golden shield wall, deep muted thump and dissolving metallic shimmer. Isolated game sound effect, no music, no speech, clean short tail.

sustain.description: A steady low fortified magical wall hum with slow restrained gold-metal resonance, seamless loop. Isolated game sound effect, no music, no speech, clean short tail.

notes: Barrier is instant, locked to facing at activation, lasts 4 s; 15 s cooldown is gameplay-owned.
Native barrier uses 57×57 to rotate a 57×38 three-by-two-cell footprint without clipping; frame metadata describes forward extent.
Barrier dissipate tags depict the final 500 ms; no protection from sides or rear.
